description: This Java class defines a Fragment called ShowcaseFragment that displays a help overlay with multiple steps, highlighting UI elements and providing navigation controls within an Android application.

classes.name: ShowcaseFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a multi-step help overlay, highlighting UI elements and allowing navigation through steps.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the StepAdapter when the fragment is attached to a context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and sets up the view hierarchy, including ViewPager and PagerTitleStrip, and configures callbacks.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Retrieves display metrics and executes the first step.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Clears highlights and runs the finish callback if set.

methods.name: setScroller
methods.description: Sets the ScrollView used for scrolling to highlighted elements.

methods.name: addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to the overlay sequence.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next step in the sequence.

methods.name: executeStep
methods.description: Displays the specified step, scrolls to target, and highlights the element.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Removes the fragment from the activity.

methods.name: clearHighlight
methods.description: Removes highlight from the previously targeted view.

methods.name: highlightView
methods.description: Highlights a specific view by changing its background and elevation.

methods.name: setOnFinish
methods.description: Sets a callback to run when the overlay is finished.
